scope: License evidence for resolved packages whose vcpkg port manifest does not declare a license. Values come from installed share/<package>/copyright files and the Qt source LICENSES directory. This is a qualification inventory, not a legal conclusion.

double-conversion.evidence: installed share/double-conversion/copyright contains the V8 project BSD 3-clause text; the port manifest declares no license

libb2.evidence: installed share/libb2/copyright contains CC0 1.0 Universal; the port manifest declares no license

opengl.evidence: vcpkg wrapper for the macOS OpenGL framework; no package license text is installed and system framework terms apply

opengl-registry.evidence: installed share/opengl-registry/copyright states that files use different per-file licenses; no single expression is asserted

qtbase.evidence: qtbase-everywhere-src-6.12.0 REUSE.toml and LICENSES directory; bundled third-party licenses are listed separately in LICENSES; the port manifest declares no license

vcpkg-make.evidence: installed share/vcpkg-make/copyright states that cmake scripts are MIT and bundled GNU Automake scripts are GPL-2.0-or-later
